row.evidence: Ironclad's pricing page only offers 'a tailored quote', and its help centre documents SCIM 2.0 at https://ironcladapp.com/scim/v2 with a SCIM-scoped token, requiring a SAML SSO connector first.
row.notes: Quote-only: no public plans or prices; every package is a custom quote, so SCIM can only be bought through sales. SCIM 2.0 is documented (Users, Groups, Schemas; create, PUT/PATCH update, deactivate via active=false, DELETE) with Okta (OIN app: SAML + SCIM create/update/deactivate/group push), Entra ID (non-gallery app plus tenant URL) and OneLogin (generic SCIM Provisioner app). SAML SSO must be configured before SCIM; SSO's plan gate is not published. JIT on SAML sign-in is available. The non-SCIM public API is a paid add-on and has no user endpoints; the Audit Log and Data Export API are part of the paid Security & Data Pro add-on.

plans.name: Custom quote
plans.notes: No tiers are published. API and integrations are listed as extras; audit log API needs the Security & Data Pro add-on.

auth.token_source: Company Settings > Integrations > SAML > SCIM Configuration tab > Token Generation (SCIM-scoped token)

operations.notes: Group DELETE is documented but deprecated/disabled (c27). Reactivation is inferred from the writable active attribute plus the UI reactivate feature; not documented as a SCIM operation.

deprovision.data_retained: Deactivated users are blocked from logging in and hidden from user pickers; the user record is kept. A SCIM DELETE removes the user and reassigns their active workflows to the admin group's default user; a company setting can require deactivation before deletion.

filtering.notes: RFC 7644 filter syntax; documented example filters on userName. Groups list also takes a filter.

pagination.notes: startIndex/count; count defaults to 25, schema maximum 1000 (OpenAPI spec on the same page).

custom.how: urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:ironclad:2.0:User (e.g. departmentHead, allowProviderConversion); new custom attributes need the SCIM Custom User Attributes feature enabled by Support

roles.how: Groups pushed via SCIM; permissions are then configured on the groups in Ironclad

rate_limits.text: Per-company buckets: SCIM users read/PUT/POST 600 RPM, users PATCH/DELETE 50 RPM, groups read 200 RPM, groups write 50 RPM, other SCIM 800 RPM; plus a 4,500 RPM company-wide cap across all APIs including SCIM.

limitations.text: Pushing users with SCIM is only supported when a single SAML configuration is in place.
Ironclad asks customers to contact Support before deprovisioning users, as it may block workflows.
Group deletion via SCIM is disabled; delete groups on the Admin Group page.
OneLogin cannot update or delete groups in Ironclad via SCIM.

scim.notes: Quote-only vendor: no plan table, so the SCIM plan is the custom quote. Whether SCIM needs the paid API add-on is not stated; the SCIM token is generated from the SAML integration page, not the API tab.

auth.notes: Scopes listed are the SCIM API's OAuth scopes from the reference index; client-credentials tokens last 6 hours.

webhooks_user_events.notes: Documented webhook event types are workflow events only; no user events listed.

rate_limits.text: Per-company, per-bucket RPM limits; 4,500 RPM company-wide cap.

user_api.notes: The public CLM API (workflows, records, entities, obligations, webhooks) needs the paid API add-on and lists no user, group or role endpoints in its full reference index (llms.txt); user management is only through the SCIM API. Marked unavailable by absence.

okta.notes: OIN app capabilities read from page markup: SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push, Group Linking (last updated Nov. 18 2021). Ironclad's guide calls it the Ironclad OIN connector; who built it is not stated.

entra.notes: Ironclad's guides use a non-gallery Entra enterprise app for SAML and point its provisioning at the generic SCIM tenant URL; no Microsoft Learn tutorial found (ironclad-tutorial 404).

onelogin.notes: Ironclad's guide uses OneLogin's generic 'SCIM Provisioner with SAML (SCIM V2)' app; OneLogin catalogue page not checked.
